title: Free BOM Analyzer
intro: Paste a bill of materials to check coverage against our catalog and get sourcing links. Basic analysis is free.
privacy: Your BOM is analyzed entirely in your browser. It is never uploaded, stored, or sent to our servers.
pasteLabel: Paste your BOM (CSV — one part per row, ideally with a header like MPN, Qty)
sampleLink: Download a sample BOM to try it
emptyErr: Paste at least one part number, or load a CSV file.
coverage: Basic analysis covers catalog coverage and sourcing links only — no live pricing, stock, or lead times. We never host datasheets; sourcing links go to the manufacturer's listing via Octopart.
ctaText: Send your requirements to our sourcing team for a quote. The free analyzer never sends your BOM — you choose what to share.
